metadata.description: Validation test for the flight controller OSD outputs (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T23): armed in acro, the throttle latches airmode, then angle mode, Alt Hold, Pos Hold, the rescue switch (which overrides both holds) and a link loss; fc_mode follows Betaflight's priority (!FS! > RESC > POSH > ALTH > ANGL > AIR > ACRO). Satellites drop to 2 in angle mode (no fix: RESCUE N/A), and mAh drawn matches the state of charge throughout.
